labels.description: The catastrophic coverage above self-insurance levels is now described as "third-party insurance coverage", and "the occurrence of significant claims" became "the incurrence of losses from significant claims" (plus a stray Table of Contents page artifact).
labels.rationale: minor: stylistic rewording with identical meaning, since coverage above self-insurance levels was already disclosed and is necessarily third-party; the risk categories, retention approach and listed adverse outcomes are unchanged, so no criterion 1 to 4 change.

labels.description: The consequence of involvement in proceedings changed from impacting "the reputation of the Company" to impacting "the brand and reputation of the Company".
labels.rationale: minor: adding "brand" beside "reputation" is stylistic rewording of the same reputational harm, with no new proceeding, exposure, likelihood or severity change under criteria 1 to 4.
